newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu leaves despite chance of summit delay.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu leaves despite chance of summit delay.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu left on Monday for an Israeli-PLO summit in Washington despite doubts that the meeting might be postponed because of Palestinian and Egyptian objections.

Netanyahu's plane took off from Tel Aviv airport without the Israeli leader speaking about reports that Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak had asked President Bill Clinton to delay the meeting.
